title: Subrogation claims denied.
bodyText: There shall be no recovery for any subrogation claim pursuant to any subrogation clause of an uninsured, underinsured, collision, or other first-party coverage as a result of payments made to persons who have claims that arise in whole or in part under this part.
bodyHtml: [§663-42]  Subrogation claims denied.  There shall be no recovery for any subrogation claim pursuant to any subrogation clause of an uninsured, underinsured, collision, or other first-party coverage as a result of payments made to persons who have claims that arise in whole or in part under this part. [L 2003, c 69, pt of §1]
